package.description: 快速且异常好用的词典 App，基于 Tauri 2 + React，提供本地离线词库和可选大模型释义。

en-US.description: Another desktop dictionary, but way more faster and definition-rich, which makes you truly understand language.
en-US.longDescription: Aictionary is a desktop dictionary focused on the word-lookup experience, built with Tauri 2 and React. It provides detailed, easy-to-understand Chinese definitions based on an open-source English-Chinese dictionary; high-frequency words are cached locally so they resolve instantly even offline. When a term is missing from the local dictionary, an optional LLM (such as OpenAI) can generate a Chinese explanation with example sentences, suited for technical and academic use. It tracks lookup history and statistics, builds a personal vocabulary, and offers keyboard shortcuts for quick lookup and clipboard queries. Native installers are provided for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

zh-CN.description: 快速且异常好用的词典 App，基于 Tauri 2 + React，提供本地离线词库和可选大模型释义。
zh-CN.longDescription: Aictionary 是一款专注于「查词体验」的桌面词典，基于开源英汉词库提供详细易懂的中文释义，常用高频词预先缓存，离线也能秒开。当本地词库没有词条时，可调用配置好的 LLM（如 OpenAI 等）生成中文解释和例句，适合技术 / 学术场景。支持查词历史与使用统计、个人词库，以及快捷键快速查词、剪贴板查询等细节优化。基于 Tauri 框架，提供 Windows / macOS / Linux 原生安装包。
zh-CN.name: Aictionary
